text: Nada, a homeless drifter, comes to Los Angeles looking for work and finds a bed in [a shanty town near a church|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised], where a preacher warns that someone has recruited the rich to control humanity. After a police raid he takes [a pair of sunglasses|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes] from a hidden box and sees the world in monochrome, its billboards ordering people to consume and conform. Through the lenses, many of the city's people are [ghoulish aliens hiding under human façades|rules|it wears a familiar face], buying [the powerful|wants|power over others] with wealth.
